parties: Krystal Integrated Services Limited acquires 100% stake in Citelum India from EDF Group (France government-owned)
headline: Krystal Integrated Services Limited acquires 100% stake in Citelum India from EDF Group
sum: Krystal Integrated Services Limited has acquired a 100% stake in Citelum India from the French state-owned EDF Group, marking a strategic consolidation in India's renewable energy and integrated services sector.
implication: Cross-border M&A involving a French state-owned enterprise requires dual-track regulatory clearance under India's FDI policy and potentially CCI scrutiny; the acquisition of a 100% stake in an operational Indian subsidiary by a domestic buyer may trigger FIPB/DPIIT review depending on prior foreign equity structures.
detail: Krystal Integrated Services Limited has completed the acquisition of Citelum India, a 100% subsidiary of EDF Group (Électricité de France), a major French state-owned utility. Citelum India operates in integrated energy services and renewable solutions in India. This transaction represents Krystal's expansion into the renewable energy and integrated services value chain. The deal was announced via an NSE-filed press release on 12 August 2026.
